purpose: Finite bookkeeping certificate for the audit-hardened reduction. It is not a semantic proof of the no-DRAW theorem.

edges.guard: typed factor frame carrying an existing LOSS token
selected valuation is at least 3; no descent below a pre-streak anchor is asserted
first valuation-two transfer has been exposed
finite tail countdown reaches a short lift
exact lift enters the generic obligation control without changing ranked data
reset after a seeded A/B2 recycle requires a strict descendant/source certificate
semantic attachment of the high-return DRAW to the marked tail
semantic attachment of a short terminal high-return row
any upward reset requires an explicit certified descendant replacement
an actual continuing DRAW has a rigorously smaller retained coefficient source
an already ranked finite token is replaced by a certified strict proof-tree descendant
marked LOSS/WIN token is replaced by a certified strict descendant

strict_exit_classes: genuine retained-source decrease proved from an actual DRAW state

open_obligations.P1: Seeded A/B2 reset provenance across multi-A streaks and all exceptional rows.
open_obligations.P2: Semantic exhaustiveness and descendant provenance for factor/high-return/marked-tail/terminal routing.

permanent_negative_regressions.forbids: smaller canonical coefficient implies smaller coefficient source when powers of three are present
high valuation after a multi-A streak implies descent below the source retained before the streak
